metadata.title: On the estimation of the Gromov-Hausdorff distance
metadata.abstract: The paper investigates the Gromov--Hausdorff distance using a new tool, the so-called $\varkappa$-traces of metric spaces. A general lower bound for the Gromov--Hausdorff distance is obtained in terms of $\varkappa$-traces. Using this bound, exact estimates for the distance between an arbitrary metric space and its Hausdorff hyperspace are derived, and the behavior of the metric on transfinite towers (inductive limits) of hyperspaces is studied. In the final part of the paper, the trace machinery is applied to $l^p$-products of metric spaces. A connection is established between computing the Gromov--Hausdorff distance for infinite $l^\infty$-products and partition calculus. Using methods from Ramsey theory (in particular, the Erdos--Rado theorem), $\varkappa$-traces for $l^\infty$-products are computed, and sufficient conditions are obtained under which the Gromov--Hausdorff distance between infinite Cartesian products can be computed exactly. The final section also provides a general estimate for the Gromov--Hausdorff distance between $l^\infty$-products of metric spaces using the Erdos--Rado theorem.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 作者引入度量空间的κ-traces，建立GH距离的一般下界，应用于空间与其Hausdorff超空间的距离估计及超空间超限塔的度量行为；还研究ℓ^p乘积，并借Erdős–Rado定理和Ramsey理论计算无限ℓ∞乘积的traces，在充分条件下精确确定乘积间GH距离。
analysis.breakthrough: 用组合集合论不变量给出GH距离的可计算障碍，并在超空间和无限乘积中得到尖锐或精确结果。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未给κ-trace定义及空间的有界性、基数或紧性条件；无限乘积精确公式有充分条件，不能泛称任意无限乘积GH距离均已算出。一般下界也不自动给匹配上界。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。23页PDF提取完整、页数匹配、无短文本页；已核对第3页致谢，全文及元数据、A.I.点写、断行/连字符模型名和Danus补检均未发现作者AI使用声明。未观察到披露不等于确认未使用。

analysis.priorityReason: 直接涉及度量比较与GH距离工具，和度量极限方向较相关。
